purpose: Externally shareable and directly downloadable human-facing physical library, separate from the JBLR technical canonical corpus.
rules: Human folders may contain physical PDF copies, not only index links.
The same canonical work may be copied into multiple human folders when its verified content spans multiple processes.
Human copy filenames use the verified internal/editorial title when known.
Technical provenance and LIB_FILE_ID stay in the index/ledger and are not required in the visible human filename.
Human copies never replace or redefine the canonical technical identity.
La Rioja remains a priority territorial human view.
Spain may remain a territorial facet integrated with general process views.
Duplicate cleanup inside the technical corpus requires verified document identity; distribution copies are intentional and are not treated as accidental duplicates.
